newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Air One denies BA acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Air One denies BA acquisition talks.

text.p: Independent Italian carrier Air One on Monday denied that it was in talks with British Airways (BA) whereby the British group would take over the Italian company.
Air One in a statement described as "completely baseless" an article in the British newspaper The Independent that BA was in talks to acquire the Italian airline.

The paper quoting BA senior management sources said that talks were at an advanced stage on the acquisition in a move that would lead to BA expanding its European operations and bringing it into head-on competition in the Italian domestic market with the state-controlled carrier Alitalia.
Air One started operating in November 1995, carried some 700,000 passengers in 1996, and has proved tough competition to Alitalia.
